name: colony
description: Self-hosted, open-source persistent AI teammates (Bots) with their own computers.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.check: npm run check -w server && npm run check -w web && npm run check --prefix desktop
